description-zh: 希尔排序（递减增量排序）
description-en: Shell sort with diminishing gap
code: void shellSort(vector<int>& a){ for(int gap=a.size()/2;gap>0;gap/=2){ for(int i=gap;i<a.size();i++){ int tmp=a[i],j=i; while(j>=gap&&a[j-gap]>tmp){ a[j]=a[j-gap]; j-=gap; } a[j]=tmp; } } }

description-zh: 二叉堆实现的堆排序
description-en: Heap sort using binary heap
code: void heapSort(vector<int>& a){ int n=a.size(); for(int i=n/2-1;i>=0;i--) heapify(a,n,i); for(int i=n-1;i>0;i--){ swap(a[0],a[i]); heapify(a,i,0); } } void heapify(vector<int>& a,int n,int i){ int largest=i,l=2*i+1,r=2*i+2; if(l<n&&a[l]>a[largest])largest=l; if(r<n&&a[r]>a[largest])largest=r; if(largest!=i){swap(a[i],a[largest]);heapify(a,n,largest);} }

description-zh: 计数排序（适用于小范围整数）
description-en: Counting sort for small integer range
code: vector<int> countingSort(const vector<int>& arr,int maxVal){ vector<int> cnt(maxVal+1,0),res(arr.size()); for(int v:arr)cnt[v]++; for(int i=1;i<=maxVal;i++)cnt[i]+=cnt[i-1]; for(int i=arr.size()-1;i>=0;i--)res[--cnt[arr[i]]=arr[i]; return res; }

description-zh: Boyer-Moore 字符串匹配（坏字符规则）
description-en: Boyer-Moore string matching
code: int boyerMoore(const string& text,const string& pattern){ int n=text.size(),m=pattern.size(); if(m==0)return 0; vector<int> bc(256,m); for(int i=0;i<m;i++) bc[pattern[i]]=m-i-1; int shift=0; while(shift<=n-m){ int j=m-1; while(j>=0&&pattern[j]==text[shift+j]) j--; if(j<0)return shift; char c=text[shift+j]; shift+=max(1,j-bc[c]); } return -1; }

description-zh: Sunday 字符串匹配算法
description-en: Sunday string matching
code: int sunday(const string& text,const string& pattern){ int n=text.size(),m=pattern.size(); if(m==0)return 0; vector<int> shift(256,m+1); for(int i=0;i<m;i++) shift[pattern[i]]=m-i; int pos=0; while(pos<=n-m){ int j=0; while(j<m&&text[pos+j]==pattern[j]) j++; if(j==m)return pos; int nextPos=pos+m; if(nextPos<n) pos+=shift[text[nextPos]]; else return -1; } return -1; }

#include <mutex> #include <chrono>
class TokenBucket{ std::mutex mu; double rate; int burst; double tokens; std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point last; public: TokenBucket(double r,int b):rate(r),burst(b),tokens(b),last(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()){} bool allow(){ std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(mu); auto now=std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); auto elapsed=std::chrono::duration<double>(now-last).count(); last=now; tokens=std::min((double)burst,tokens+elapsed*rate); if(tokens>=1){ tokens--; return true; } return false; } };

code:
#include <vector> #include <string>
class BloomFilter{ size_t size_; std::vector<bool> bits_; public: BloomFilter(size_t s):size_(s),bits_(s,false){} size_t h1(const std::string& s)const{size_t h=0;for(char c:s)h=h*31+c;return h%size_;} size_t h2(const std::string& s)const{size_t h=0;for(char c:s)h=h*17+c;return h%size_;} void insert(const std::string& s){bits_[h1(s)]=true;bits_[h2(s)]=true;} bool contains(const std::string& s)const{return bits_[h1(s)]&&bits_[h2(s)];} };

description-zh: 简化的 YAML 配置解析器
description-en: Simplified YAML config parser
code: std::unordered_map<std::string,std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string>> parseYAML(const std::string& content){ std::unordered_map<std::string,std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string>> cfg; std::istringstream iss(content); std::string line,section; while(std::getline(iss,line)){ if(line.empty()||line[0]=='#')continue; if(line[0]=='['){ size_t p=line.find(']'); section=line.substr(1,p-1); } else if(line.find('=')!=std::string::npos){ size_t p=line.find('='); std::string k=line.substr(0,p),v=line.substr(p+1); cfg[section][k]=v; } } return cfg; }
